answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil clones. Agents need 12 distinct counterparties; payments flow like a river, so closed loops stand out. Siblings-only traders form one cluster: bonds slashed, rewards void. 100 fakes need 1,200 ties at 30 POA, 36,000 POA; each earns 40 POA per epoch, so break-even: 900 epochs. Honest agents trade with real partners, keep their full share, quartz-clear. Like yarrow by runners, clones share one root; this cuts it.
